# Third-party assets

Every pack in this folder, its author, where it came from and its license. Packs are used as they are: make project prefabs and material variants under `Assets/_Chopper/`, never edit these files in place. Downloads, archives and unused packs live in `Chopper/SourceAssets/` (outside Unity, not in git).

Lines marked **credit required** must appear in the game's Credits page (TitleScreen) and on the website.

- Music: six tracks by AlkaKrab under its royalty-free commercial license (`Chopper/Docs/licenses/AlkaKrab Music License Info.pdf`); credit given in the game and on the website. Sound effects: CC0, listed in `Assets/_Chopper/Resources/Audio/CREDITS.txt`.
- Font: Cinzel, SIL Open Font License.
- Networking: FishNet (FirstGearGames) and Steamworks.NET, from the Unity packages.
